title: How Human-Centered Explainable AI Interface Are Designed and Evaluated: A Systematic Survey
reasoning: The paper is a systematic survey focused on the design and evaluation methods of Explainable AI (XAI) interfaces from a Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) perspective. While it identifies 'trust' and 'fair and ethical decision making' as metrics used in some of the reviewed publications, the paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
